BOTH printed form pages carry nothing but the words 'See Attached' written between two hand-drawn stars, with the SUBTOTAL cell blank and only the TOTAL cell filled - so all itemization lives on the attachments, which are headed 'Contributions through 1/31/13' and 'EXPENDITURES THROUGH 1-31-13'. THIS IS THE ONLY FILING IN THE CHUNK WITH REAL DONOR CITY AND STATE ON EVERY ROW: the attachment prints separate ADDRESS, CITY, STATE and ZIP columns, the county's black redaction bar covers only the ADDRESS cells of rows 1-2, and the CITY ('Salt Lake') and STATE ('UT') columns are outside the bar and legible throughout. City is recorded verbatim as 'Salt Lake' - it is NOT normalised to 'Salt Lake City'. No ZIP is recorded (not a contract field, and neither a city nor a state), and no street address was read or written anywhere. IN-KIND IS BOOKED ON BOTH SIDES AND RECONCILES: Internet Properties appears as a $600.00 'In Kind' CONTRIBUTION on 11/15/2012 and as a $600.00 'In Kind' expenditure for 'Rent' on the same date - donated office rent, and both printed totals include it, which is why both sides gate only when the in-kind rows are counted. ONE FILER DATE TYPO IS RETAINED VERBATIM: the first expenditure is dated '11/7/2013' on a schedule that runs through 1-31-13 and whose other rows are Nov/Dec 2012; the year was not corrected.
